an8.30:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā bhaggesu viharati suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye.
an8.30:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā anuruddhe cetīsu viharati pācīnavaṃsadāye.
an8.30:1.3: atha kho āyasmato anuruddhassa rahogatassa patisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi:
an8.30:1.7: āraddha viriyassāyaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassa,
an8.30:1.10: paññāvato ayaṃ dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassāti.
an8.30:2.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmato anuruddhassa cetasā cetoparivitakkamaññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya evameva bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye antarahito cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhe pāturahosi.
an8.30:2.3: āyasmāpi kho anuruddho bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
an8.30:2.4: ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.30:3.2: sādhu kho tvaṃ anuruddha, yaṃ taṃ mahāpurisavitakkaṃ vitakkesi:
an8.30:3.9: paññavato ayaṃ dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassāti.
an8.30:3.10: tena hi tvaṃ anuruddha, imampi aṭṭhamaṃ mahāpurisavitakkaṃ vitakkehi:
an8.30:3.11: nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ dhammo nippapañcaratino nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratinoti.
an8.30:4.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ anuruddha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:5.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi tato tvaṃ anuruddha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:6.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi tato tvaṃ anuruddha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi, pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca viharissasi, sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedissasi, yaṃ taṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:7.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, tato tvaṃ anuruddha, yāvadeva ākaṅkhissasi, sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharissasi.
an8.30:8.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime ca aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi, akicchalābhī, akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha, seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānārattānaṃ dussānaṃ dussakaraṇḍako pūro,
an8.30:8.2: evameva te paṃsukūlaṃ cīvarānaṃ khāyissati, santuṭṭhassa viharato, ratiyā aparitassāya, phāsuvihārāya, okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:9.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime ca aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi, akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha, seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā sālīnaṃ odano vigatakāḷako anekasūpo anekavyañjano,
an8.30:9.2: evameva te piṇḍiyālopaṃ bhojanānaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:10.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime ca aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi, akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha, seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā kūṭāgāraṃ ullittāvalittaṃ nivātaṃ phussitaggaḷaṃ pihitavātapānaṃ,
an8.30:10.2: evameva te rukkhamūlaṃ senāsanānaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:11.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime ca aṭṭhamahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, imesaṃ ca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi, akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha, seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā pallaṅko goṇakatthato paṭikatthato paṭalikatthato kādalimigapavarapaccattharaṇo sauttaracchado ubhato lohitakūpadhāno,
an8.30:11.2: evameva te tiṇasanthārako sayanāsanānaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:12.1: yato kho tvaṃ anuruddha, ime ca aṭṭha mahāpurisavitakke vitakkessasi, imesañca catunnaṃ jhānānaṃ ābhicetasikānaṃ diṭṭhadhammasukhavihārānaṃ nikāmalābhī bhavissasi akicchalābhī akasiralābhī, tato tuyhaṃ anuruddha, seyyathāpi nāma gahapatissa vā gahapatiputtassa vā nānā bhesajjāni, seyyathīdaṃ: sappinavanītaṃ telaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ.
an8.30:12.2: evameva te pūtimuttaṃ bhesajjānaṃ khāyissati santuṭṭhassa viharato ratiyā aparitassāya phāsuvihārāya okkamanāya nibbānassa.
an8.30:12.3: tena hi tvaṃ anuruddha, āyatikampi vassāvāsaṃ idheva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye vihareyyāsīti.
an8.30:12.4: evaṃ bhanteti kho āyasmā anuruddho bhagavato paccassosi.
an8.30:13.1: atha kho bhagavā āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ iminā ovādena ovaditvā seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evameva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye antarahito bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakalāvane migadāye pāturahosi.
an8.30:13.4: aṭṭha kho bhikkhave, mahāpurisavitakke desissāmi, taṃ suṇātha sādhukaṃ manasi karotha bhāsissāmīti. evambhanteti kho te bhikkhu bhagavato paccassosuṃ bhagavā etadavoca:
an8.30:13.5: katame ca bhikkhave, aṭṭha mahā purisavitakkā:
an8.30:13.6: appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassa;
an8.30:13.7: santuṭṭhassāyaṃ bhikkhave dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassa;
an8.30:13.8: pavivittassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇikārāmassa.
an8.30:13.9: āraddhaviriyassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassa,
an8.30:13.10: upaṭṭhitasatissāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo muṭṭhassatissa.
an8.30:13.11: samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassa.
an8.30:13.12: paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassa,
an8.30:13.13: nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nippapañcaratino nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino.
an8.30:14.1: appicchassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo mahicchassā’ti
an8.30:14.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:14.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhu appiccho samāno appicchoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, santuṭṭho samāno santuṭṭhoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, pavivitto samāno pavivittoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, āraddhaviriyo samāno āraddhaviriyoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, upaṭṭhitasati samāno upaṭṭhitasatīti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, samāhito samāno samāhitoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, paññavā samāno paññavāti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati, nippapañcārāmo samāno nippapaññārāmoti maṃ jāneyyunti na icchati.
an8.30:14.5: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:15.1: ‘santuṭṭhassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo asantuṭṭhassā’ ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:15.3: ‘santuṭṭhassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo asaṭṭhantussā’ ti
an8.30:15.4: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:16.1: ‘pavivittassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo, nāyaṃ dhammo saṅgaṇikārāmassā’ ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:16.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhuno pavivittassa viharato bhavanti upasaṅkamitāro bhikkhu bhikkhuniyo, upāsakā upāsikāyo rājāno rājamahāmattā titthiyā titthiyasāvakā.
an8.30:16.3: tatra bhikkhu vivekaninnena cittena vivekapoṇena vivekapabbhārena vavakaṭṭhena nekkhammābhiratena aññadatthu uyyojanikapaṭisaṃyuttaṃyeva kathaṃ kattā hoti.
an8.30:16.5: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:17.1: ‘āraddhaviriyassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo kusītassā’ti iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:17.2: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu āraddhaviriyo viharati akusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ pahānāya kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ upasampadāya thāmavā daḷhaparakkamo anikkhittadhuro kusalesu dhammesu
an8.30:17.4: iti yaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:18.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:18.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu satimā hoti paramena satinepakkena samannāgato cirakatampi cirabhāsitampi saritā anussaritā.
an8.30:18.5: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:19.1: ‘samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassā’ ti
an8.30:19.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:19.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu vivicceva kāmehi …pe… catutthaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharati.
an8.30:19.4: ‘samāhitassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo asamāhitassā’ ti
an8.30:19.5: iti yantaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:20.1: ‘paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā’ti
an8.30:20.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:20.3: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu paññavā hoti udayatthagāminiyā paññāya samannāgato ariyāya nibbedhikāya sammādukkhakkhayagāminiyā.
an8.30:20.4: ‘paññavato ayaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nāyaṃ dhammo duppaññassā’ ti
an8.30:20.5: iti yaṃ taṃ vuttaṃ idametaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ.
an8.30:21.1: ‘nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nippapañcaratino nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino’ ti
an8.30:21.2: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, kiñcetaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ:
an8.30:21.3: idha bhikkhave bhikkhuno papañcanirodhe cittaṃ pakkhandati pasīdati, santiṭṭhati, vimuccati,
an8.30:21.4: ‘nippapañcārāmassāyaṃ bhikkhave, dhammo nippapañcaratino nāyaṃ dhammo papañcārāmassa papañcaratino’ti
an8.30:21.5: iti kho panetaṃ vuttaṃ, idametaṃ paṭicca vuttanti.
an8.30:22.1: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho āyatikampi vassāvāsaṃ tattheva cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye vihāsi.
an8.30:22.2: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti, tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariya pariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi.
an8.30:22.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ ittatthāyāti abbhaññāsi.
an8.30:22.4: aññataro ca panāyasmā anuruddho arahataṃ ahosi.
an8.30:22.5: atha kho āyasmā anuruddho arahattappatto tāyaṃ velāyaṃ imā gāthāyo abhāsi.
